chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Kūfī, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Makfūf, from ʿAmr al-Ahwāzī, who said:
Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام showed me his son and said: “This is your Master after me.”

key_terms.أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ: A title referring to Imam al-Ḥasan al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام in this report.
key_terms.ابْنَهُ: His son, whom he presented as the successor after him.
key_terms.صَاحِبُكُمْ: Your master or leader, referring to the designated Imam.
key_terms.مِنْ بَعْدِي: After me; indicating succession following the speaker.

ai.seo_question: How did Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام indicate the Imam after him?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام explicitly showed his son to a narrator and identified him as the one who would hold authority after him. Its significance lies in affirming the succession of the Imam and indicating the continuity of the Imamate.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Kufy, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Makfouf, from Amro Al Ahwazy who said,
‘Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) showed me his<sup>asws</sup> son and said: ‘This is your Master<sup>asws</sup> from after me<sup>asws</sup>’’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad al-Kufi from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad al-Makfuf from ‘Amr al-Ahwazi who has said the following.
“Abu Muhammad (a.s.) showed me his son and said, “This will be your master (Leader with Divine Authority) after me.”
